race.comment: HARMONIC DANCER (12) has been a beaten favourite in both if his starts back from a spell, and he did not help himself here 5 weeks ago when racing ungenerously. He has been given time to get over that last effort, and would also have had his racing issues ironed out in this time. The step up to 1200m could be a query, but he is up to winning this. Follow your money. DAMPEN (6) posted a rare win at Gawler in his penultimate start, and then fought on gamely for third at this level here last week. Rochelle Milnes picks up the ride, which will negate his wide draw, and he has each-way claims again. ARTISTIC GENIUS (2) hops the border after some solid runs in Victoria on heavy tracks recently, but he is also adept on good ground too. His stable has a good strike rate when travelling their team, so stick with him. HOWL (1) is a durable veteran who bounced back into form when finishing third at Murray Bridge a fortnight ago. Include in all top 4 combos. ROUSING REFRAIN (8) has top 4 claims.
